2. Heard Sri Brijesh Kumar Yadav, Advocate holding brief of Sri Janardan Yadav, learned counsel for applicants as well as Sri R.P. Patel, learned Additional Government Advocate for State.

3. The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Case Crime No.376 of 2022, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 308 and 34 I.P.C., P.S. Ahraula, District Azamgarh.

4. After arguing for some time, applicants' counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Avanish Yadav And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163469587/

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the applicants.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference U/s 438 Cr.P.C.

The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicants shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7. For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicants before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants- Avanish Yadav, Lal Chand Yadav, Mool Chand Yadav and Sachin Yadav, in the above case.
